_OBJECTIVE: Verify that X-band PSR (9 GHz frequency tag) shows more Pd reduction than S-band in the SAME rain conditions. Uses 16 mm/hr (matching TC-03) so the ONLY variable is frequency.
_PASS_CRITERIA: X-band target detection count < S-band target detection count at same rain rate. This isolates the frequency-dependent attenuation from rain rate effects.
_NOTE: Previous version used 50 mm/hr which inflated weather clutter count and made comparison unfair. Now both TC-03 and TC-04 use 16 mm/hr.
description: TC-04: X-band PSR (9 GHz) in moderate rain (16 mm/hr) — same rain rate as TC-03 for fair comparison
